standard.summary: 控制 source/reference 信息如何影响 target noisy latent。默认 none 不注入；latent_residual 和 masked_residual 是不增加 token 数的安全策略。
standard.effect: latent_residual 使用 sample + strength * (source - sample)。masked_residual 会用 edit_mask 抑制编辑区域的 reference residual，并用 preserve_mask 锁住保留区域。
standard.whenToUse: paired edit batch 已提供 source_latents 或后续 adapter 能提供参考 latent 时。masked_residual 适合有编辑区域或保留区域 mask 的数据。
standard.avoidWhen: 还没有 source/target latent 或 mask 语义不确定时先用 none。cross_attention_reference_tokens、self_attention_kv_reference、native_control_path 目前需要模型族 adapter 显式支持。

optionDescriptions.none: 不往 noisy latent 里塞参考残差。
optionDescriptions.masked_residual: 只在 mask 里 residual，区外更好保原。

standard_en.summary: Governs how source/reference information reaches the target noisy latent. The default none injects nothing; latent_residual and masked_residual are safe strategies that add no tokens.
standard_en.effect: latent_residual uses sample + strength * (source - sample). masked_residual uses edit_mask to suppress the reference residual inside the edit region, and preserve_mask to lock the region being kept.
standard_en.whenToUse: When the paired edit batch already supplies source_latents, or a later adapter can supply the reference latent. masked_residual suits data that has an edit-region or preserve-region mask.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Stay on none while there are no source/target latents yet, or the mask semantics are unclear. cross_attention_reference_tokens, self_attention_kv_reference and native_control_path currently need explicit adapter support from the model family.

optionDescriptions.none: Puts no reference residual into the noisy latent.
optionDescriptions.latent_residual: A whole-image residual; no growth in token count.
optionDescriptions.masked_residual: A residual inside the mask only, which preserves the outside better.

advanced.principle: 第一版避免直接 2L self-attention 拼接，先用 shape-compatible latent residual 降低激活显存风险。更强的 attention/token 注入策略保留为 adapter-hooked 合同。
advanced.intervention: forward-input stage 在模型 forward 前改写 sample 或记录 adapter-hook 需求。
advanced.expectedImpact: 降低像素漂移，同时避免早期实现引入 attention 激活爆炸。
advanced.tradeoffs: reference_strength 太高会复印 source，太低会保留不足；应配合 edit_timestep_schedule 调整。

advanced_en.principle: V1 avoids direct 2L self-attention concatenation and first uses shape-compatible latent residual to reduce activation-VRAM risk. Stronger attention/token injection strategies are kept as an adapter-hooked contract.
advanced_en.intervention: The forward-input stage rewrites the sample or records adapter-hook needs before the model forward.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Reduces pixel drift while avoiding the attention-activation blowup early implementations risked.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: reference_strength too high photocopies the source, too low preserves too little; tune alongside edit_timestep_schedule.
